audit.whatIsWrong: Trundle's W and E are swapped in three places — Pillar of Ice is called his W and Frozen Domain his E. Chomp is described as armour shred. And the sustain that actually decides this lane is never explained.
audit.why: Riot's text: Frozen Domain is the W (750 range, 18/17/16/15/14s) — a zone giving attack speed, move speed and INCREASED HEALING FROM ALL SOURCES. Pillar of Ice is the E (1000 range, 21/19.5/18/16.5/15s) — impassable terrain that slows, so it walls your retreat rather than closing a gap. Chomp saps ATTACK DAMAGE, not armour. King's Tribute heals him whenever a unit dies near him, which is why Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: Pillar of Ice is his E: 1000 range, 21s at rank 1, impassable terrain that pins you rather than closing distance — never fight with it behind you. Frozen Domain is the W and raises his healing from every source. Chomp saps your AD, not your armour. King's Tribute heals him off every minion death nearby, so buy anti-heal early or the chip never sticks.
sources: kits: trundle W Frozen Domain range 750 cd 18-14, E Pillar of Ice range 1000 cd 21-15 terrain flag, Q Chomp text, P King's Tribute text

notes: Slot swap corrected: the page called Pillar of Ice his W and Frozen Domain his E in three places. Pillar of Ice is the E (1000 range, 21s, impassable terrain) and — importantly for a champion with no dash — it walls your retreat rather than closing a gap, which flips the advice from 'sidestep his initiation' to 'never fight with terrain behind you'. Frozen Domain is the W and raises his healing from all sources, which together with King's Tribute is the real reason anti-heal decides this lane. Also corrected Chomp: it saps attack damage, not armour, and it is an auto reset on 3.5s so the wind-up is the tell. Chart untouched — it already matches the mirror's instruction exactly. Packet suspectName 'Your Mega Inferno Bomb' is a false positive. Per the mirror, the content layer elsewhere on this champion claims Ziggs has 'no mobility spell'; Satchel Charge knocks Ziggs clear and deals him no damage, so that claim is wrong wherever it appears — it does not occur in this matchup's writable text, so there was nothing to edit here.
